description: This file contains unit tests for the TalkConfigParsing component, validating the selection and fallback logic for provider configurations within a speech or voice configuration system.

methods.name: preferCanonicalResolvedTalkProviderPayload
methods.description: Tests that the provider configuration selection correctly prefers the canonical resolved payload with the 'elevenlabs' provider.

methods.name: rejectsNormalizedTalkProviderPayloadWithoutResolved
methods.description: Verifies that the selection function returns nil when a normalized payload is present without a corresponding 'resolved' key.

methods.name: fallsBackToLegacyTalkFieldsWhenNormalizedPayloadMissing
methods.description: Checks fallback to legacy fields when normalized payload data is missing.

methods.name: canDisableLegacyFallback
methods.description: Tests that disabling legacy fallback results in nil when only legacy fields are present.

methods.name: rejectsNormalizedPayloadWhenProviderMissingFromProviders
methods.description: Ensures rejection when the provider specified is missing from the providers list.

methods.name: rejectsNormalizedPayloadWhenMultipleProvidersAndNoProvider
methods.description: Validates that selection returns nil when multiple providers are configured but no provider is specified.

methods.name: bridgesFoundationDictionary
methods.description: Tests the conversion of a Foundation dictionary into the internal format, ensuring nested values are correctly interpreted.

methods.name: resolvesPositiveIntegerTimeout
methods.description: Verifies correct resolution of positive integer timeout values with fallbacks.
